action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that PHP incorrectly handled out-of-memory conditions
while processing requests. A remote attacker could use this issue to
execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-109618)

It was discovered that PHP incorrectly managed internal request state
across worker reuse. A remote attacker could use this issue to execute
arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-109619)
isummary:
PHP could be made to crash or run programs if it received specially
crafted network traffic.
title: PHP vulnerabilities
